attractions.name: Black River Gorges National Park
attractions.description: Largest national park in Mauritius, covering about 67.54 sq km of rainforest, rivers, waterfalls and hills. Popular for hiking, birdwatching and wildlife viewing, and protects many endangered and endemic species.
attractions.recommended_duration: 5–6 hrs total for the whole region including Alexandra Falls and La Vallée des Couleurs

attractions.name: Alexandra Falls Viewpoint
attractions.description: Waterfall dropping about 500 feet, with several lookouts over the falls and surrounding valley.

attractions.name: La Vallée des Couleurs Nature Park
attractions.description: Nature park in the tropical forest with colourful earth, hanging bridges and panoramic landscapes. Activities include zip lining, hiking and quad biking.
